children: Overview
China packaging paper maker's annual revenue grew 18.6% yr/yr, driven by higher sales volume
Net profit attributable to equity holders rose 102.6% yr/yr, basic EPS up 100%
Company benefited from cost control and premium product offerings amid industry recovery
Outlook
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for revenue or profit in the press release
Result Drivers
SALES VOLUME - Co said sales volume rose 14% yr/yr to a record 24.5 mln tonnes, boosting revenue
HIGHER SELLING PRICES - Co said average selling price increased 4% yr/yr, supporting revenue growth
PRODUCT MIX OPTIMIZATION - Co said increased sales proportion of high-end kraftliner products boosted profit contribution
